values.note: Iron County, 2026: daily $45, monthly $750, seasonal $2,060 (limited number of seasonal sites); one rate for everyone. A 3% convenience fee on credit-card payments. Reservation fees are non-refundable.

fees.source: https://parks.ironmi.com/parks/ (notice read 2026-10-15, audit/price_research/local_mi_2026-10-15/mi_pages.jsonl: 'Camping fees have increased for the 2026 season | Seasonal - $2060 | Monthly - $750 | Daily - $45 | We only have a limited number of Seasonal Sites'; the page still says on 2026-10-25 'All Credit Card transactions will have a 3% convenience fee added, Camping fees have increased for the 2026 season')

hookups.source: https://ironmi.com/pentoga-park + https://parks.ironmi.com/parks/ ('135 camp scenic camp sites with water and 30-amp electrical hook-up. No sewer. Dump station available.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The county's camping page says 134 sites; the park page and booking home page say 135. One camper per site.

sites.source: https://ironmi.com/pentoga-park ('135 camp scenic camp sites', 'Only one camper per camp site') + https://parks.ironmi.com/parks/camping/ ('Pentoga Park has 134 camp scenic camp sites'), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://ironmi.com/pentoga-park ('Two shower/bathroom facilities within the campground', 'Dump station available', 'Campground store with: Firewood, Ice machine, Ice cream, Camp necessities, Snacks and drinks'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Book online on Iron County Parks' reservation site or by phone ('Call for reservations', 906-265-3979). Check in at the office before setting up. Cancelling 30+ days out is refunded in full, 7-30 days 50%, under 7 days nothing; refunds come as a voucher.

booking.source: https://ironmi.com/pentoga-park ('Click here to make an online reservation', 'Reservations: ... Call for reservations', cancellation policy) + https://parks.ironmi.com/parks/ ('Book a Campsite Online'), read 2026-10-25

note: Iron County park on Chicagon Lake (1630 County Rd 424, Crystal Falls). Beach (no lifeguard) with a changing house, waterfront cook stoves, playground; historic Chippewa (Ojibwa) burial grounds preserved on site. Opens the Friday before Memorial Day through September. --Claude
summary: County park page + Iron County Parks booking site: confirmed 135 sites, 30 A + water, no sewer, dump, reservable (online or phone), $45 daily (2026 notice read 2026-10-15; page still announces the 2026 increase); added showers, camp store, monthly/seasonal rates and 3% card fee. Seasonal sites 'limited' (no count; passes test 4). Note trimmed of hookups/count/booking.
